香港中文大学（深圳）

    科目及教学评估问卷操作指引
        A quick guide to
Online Course and Teaching Evaluation
        Questionnaire (OCTE)




                                         30. Apr 2020

Please log in to the system with your CUHKSZ ID.                                                          c
    Please visit [link]
    Log in with your CUHK(SZ) account and password
1、Check “Your Course List”, select a course, then click “Begin”.

2、Answer the questions with care. You need to finish the form in one go. After completing it, click
“Submit”.

3、Click “Courses Evaluated” to view the detail of the questionnaire you have submitted, but no revision
is allowed.
